description: Bounded source-faithful multiple-input signature register simulation with deterministic lrand48 noise and ASCII report output.

pinned_source.license_note: The referenced C source has no explicit license notice; these are independently written algorithm ports.

source_bound.description: The launcher supplies no arguments. The source fixes reg_len=num_vect=10 and prob=0.25, uses default structure 1000000000 and seed48 words {1,0,0}, and runs 100000 experiments (30000 with SMALL_PROBLEM_SIZE). Each experiment copies the current good register into the faulty register, executes ten vectors through the two MISRs, then records whether any of the ten visible cells differ. The suite uses experiments as its scalar and bounds it to 1..1000. It preserves the POSIX 48-bit lrand48 recurrence, source register/update order, and two-line report while bounding runtime.
source_bound.source_output_format: header printf followed by reg_len, num_vect, prob, num_times, structure, seeds, and (num_times-num_true)/num_times with %.8e
source_bound.invalid_suite_case: The suite rejects experiment counts outside 1..1000; the pinned main does not parse a runtime experiment count.

input.meaning: Number of independent ten-vector MISR experiments, with source register, probability, structure, and seeds fixed to launcher defaults.

output.encoding: The original report header, a space-prefixed parameter/result line, and LF endings.
output.definition: The two source printf outputs, including the space after the first LF; the final field is the fraction of experiments whose good and faulty visible registers match, formatted in scientific notation with eight fractional digits.
